corrected_content.problem:
Given the system of equations below, what is the value of $p - q$?

$$
\displaystyle \left\{\begin{aligned}5q + 55 &=0 \\ 2p + 3q + 3 &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$
corrected_content.worked_solution: From $5q+55=0$, we obtain $q=-11$. Substituting into the second equation gives $2p-33+3=0$, so $p=15$. Therefore $p-q=15-(-11)=26$.
